questions.question: Give three reasons why animals need food.
questions.expected_answer: Animals need food for energy to carry out their life processes, such as moving, breathing and keeping warm; to grow; and to repair their bodies when they are hurt.

questions.question: Explain why plants are called the primary food source for animals, even for animals that eat only meat.
questions.expected_answer: Only plants can make their own food. Herbivores eat plants, and carnivores eat animals that ate plants. So all animal food starts with plants. For example, a lion eats zebra, and zebra eat grass.

questions.question: What are herbivores, carnivores and omnivores? Give two examples of each.
questions.expected_answer: Herbivores eat only plants, such as rhinos, zebra, giraffes or elephants. Carnivores eat other animals, such as lions, leopards, eagles or crocodiles. Omnivores eat plants and animals, such as baboons, bushpigs, chickens or people.
